title: 第2262章 炼化葫芦第2261章 黑色石头
content_zh:
之前在街上，他买下那块黑色石头的时候，青葫芦便发出了震颤，此刻他将那块石头从储物戒中取了出来，连同之前从那中年男子储物戒中分到的那枚碎片一起放在桌上。
果不其然，葫芦口的塞子自行弹开，一股强大的吸力从葫芦口中涌出，将那块黑色石头连同那枚碎片一起吸入了葫芦之中。
那黑色石头与不知名碎片正在以一种肉眼可见的速度被炼化，化作一缕缕乳白色的液体在葫芦底部汇聚。
那股液体散发着晶莹剔透的光泽，比之前用灵药炼化出来的灵液更加精纯，更加浓郁，仅仅是从葫芦口飘出的那一缕雾气，便让叶无尘精神为之一振。
他之前拿自己储物戒当中的物品实验过，那些普通的物品根本无法让青葫芦有任何反应。
而此刻那块黑色石头与碎片能够让青葫芦主动吞噬，恐怕不是什么凡物。
葫芦内部的炼化还在继续，那股乳白色的灵液越来越多，从最初的一小缕变成了一小滩，在葫芦底部缓缓流转，散发着淡淡的光晕。
约莫过了一炷香的时间，葫芦内部的炼化终于完成。
那只青色葫芦发出一声轻微的嗡鸣，葫芦口处飘出一缕浓郁的雾气，将整间客房都笼罩在一片氤氲的香气之中。
叶无尘睁开眼睛，伸手将葫芦拿起，凑到眼前望去。
葫芦底部，静静地躺着一小滩乳白色的灵液，约莫有三口之多。
那灵液晶莹剔透，光是闻到这股香气，他便感觉体内的仙力隐隐有了一丝躁动，仿佛在渴望着什么。
“希望这些灵液能够让我直接突破到仙尊境。”叶无尘轻声开口。眼中闪过一丝兴奋。
他没有再犹豫，将葫芦口凑到嘴边，仰头将底部那滩灵液全部倒入喉中。
灵液入喉的瞬间，一股磅礴到极致的灵力在他体内猛然炸开！
那股灵力如同决堤的洪水，在他经脉中疯狂奔涌，所过之处，经脉被撑得鼓胀起来，仿佛随时都可能被撑破。
叶无尘的脸色微微一变，他低估了这股灵液的力量。
那些灵液进入体内之后，直接化作最精纯的灵力，一遍又一遍地冲击着他的经脉、丹田、四肢百骸。
那股力量太狂暴了，也太磅礴了，即便以他肉身的强度，都有些难以承受。
叶无尘盘坐在床上，双目紧闭，额头上青筋暴起，脸色涨红，体内的经脉被那股狂暴的灵力撑得鼓胀起来，隐隐有要碎裂的迹象。

他深吸一口气，心神沉入体内，开始引导那股狂暴的灵力。
不朽不灭经缓缓运转，造化古树的力量从四肢百骸中涌出，与那股仙力融合在一起，滋养着他的经脉、血肉、骨骼。
生之真意在体内流转，翠绿色的光华在他体内游走，修复着那些被仙力冲击得受损的经脉。
三种力量同时运转，形成了一种微妙的平衡。
那股磅礴的仙力在不朽不灭经的引导下，一点一点地被驯服，沿着经脉缓缓运转，最终汇入丹田之中。
丹田中，仙力如同沸腾的海洋，翻滚不休。
叶无尘能感受到，自己距离仙境巅峰的极限越来越近，那道通往仙尊境的门槛就在眼前，只差临门一脚。
“轰！轰！轰！”
连续数道沉闷的声响从叶无尘体内传出，每一道声响都让他的气息暴涨一截，那股气势越来越强，越来越可怕。
终于……
一道清脆的声响在他体内炸开，如同打破了一层无形的屏障。
content_en:
When he bought the black stone on the street, Qing Gourd trembled. Now he took the stone out of the storage ring and put it on the table together with the fragment he had received from the middle-aged man's storage ring.
Sure enough, the stopper at the mouth of the gourd popped open on its own, and a strong suction force surged out from the mouth of the gourd, sucking the black stone into the gourd together with the fragment.
The black stone and unknown fragments were being refined at a speed visible to the naked eye, turning into wisps of milky white liquid that gathered at the bottom of the gourd.
The liquid exuded a crystal clear luster, and was purer and richer than the spiritual liquid refined with the elixir before. Just the wisp of mist floating out of the gourd mouth lifted Ye Wuchen's spirit.
He had experimented with the items in his storage ring before, and those ordinary items couldn't make Qing Gourd react at all.
At this moment, the black stone and fragments can be swallowed by the green gourd. I am afraid it is not a mortal thing.
The refining inside the gourd continued, and the milky white spiritual liquid became more and more abundant. It turned from a small wisp at the beginning into a small pool, slowly flowing at the bottom of the gourd, emitting a faint halo.
After about a stick of incense, the refining inside the gourd was finally completed.
The green gourd made a slight buzzing sound, and a thick mist floated from the mouth of the gourd, covering the entire room in a dense aroma.
Ye Wuchen opened his eyes, reached out to pick up the gourd, and looked at it.
At the bottom of the gourd, there was a small pool of milky white spiritual liquid lying quietly, about three mouthfuls in size.
The spiritual liquid was crystal clear, and just by smelling the aroma, he felt a faint restlessness in the immortal power in his body, as if he was longing for something.
"I hope these spiritual liquids can allow me to directly break through to the Immortal Realm." Ye Wuchen said softly. A flash of excitement flashed in his eyes.
Without any further hesitation, he brought the mouth of the gourd to his mouth, raised his head and poured all the spiritual liquid at the bottom into his throat.
The moment the spiritual liquid entered his throat, a majestic and extremely powerful spiritual power suddenly exploded in his body!
That spiritual power was like a flood that broke a bank, rushing wildly through his meridians. Wherever it passed, the meridians were bulging, as if they might burst at any time.
Ye Wuchen's expression changed slightly, he underestimated the power of this spiritual fluid.
After the spiritual liquid entered the body, it directly turned into the purest spiritual power, impacting his meridians, Dantian, and limbs over and over again.
The power was so violent and majestic that even with the strength of his body, it was a bit unbearable.
Ye Wuchen sat cross-legged on the bed, his eyes closed tightly, veins popped up on his forehead, his face flushed, and the meridians in his body were swollen by the violent spiritual power, and there were faint signs of breaking.
He took a deep breath, his mind sank into his body, and began to channel the violent spiritual power.
The Immortal Sutra rotates slowly, and the power of the ancient tree of creation pours out from the limbs and bones, merging with the immortal power to nourish his meridians, flesh, and bones.
The true meaning of life circulates in his body, and the emerald green light swims in his body, repairing the meridians that were damaged by the impact of the immortal power.
Three forces operate simultaneously, forming a delicate balance.
Under the guidance of the Immortal Sutra, the majestic immortal power was tamed bit by bit, slowly running along the meridians, and finally merged into the Dantian.
In the dantian, the immortal power is like a boiling ocean, rolling endlessly.
Ye Wuchen could feel that he was getting closer and closer to the limit of the peak of the Immortal Realm. The threshold to the Immortal Realm was right in front of him, and he was only one step away.
"Boom! Boom! Boom!"
Several consecutive dull sounds came from Ye Wuchen's body, and each sound made his aura surge. The momentum became stronger and stronger, becoming more and more terrifying.
Finally...
A crisp sound exploded inside his body, as if an invisible layer had been broken.barrier.
